about: The workspace keys the Einsatzleiter function (role `el`) may write through the record slice
(PUT /api/incidents/{id}/workspace/record). The server reads this file as
app/api/incidents.py · RECORD_WORKSPACE_KEYS, and the client sends exactly these keys
(src/lib/api/workspaceSync.ts · RECORD_SLICE_KEYS): a key the server does not allow is dropped
there, so sending it would only fake a successful save. Widening the set is a deliberate
decision with a doc change attached (docs/API.md · roles). Checked by
